plan: Separate session state, action validation, screen construction, and replaceable console I/O.
Validate each action completely before mutating session data.
Generate fresh, deterministic screen dictionaries and verify behavior through the frozen API.
mechanisms: A four-key session dictionary is the authoritative mutable state.
Private handlers validate preconditions and payload types before committing changes.
A centralized screen builder controls prompts, messages, and ordered appointment choices.
Error screens derive from unchanged state and always begin with an `Error:` message.
Constructor-injected action source and screen sink provide standard-library-friendly test seams.
